subject: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) & technical deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2024 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + next steps after today's discovery call

Thanks for running through things today — really appreciate the thorough demo and the discussion. A quick recap from our side: we liked the performance characteristics you mentioned and the routing/isolated deployment options look promising.

Our CTO (Priya Shah) wants a short executive alignment call to make sure leadership is comfortable with the approach before we move on to a technical deep dive. We're also keen on a technical session with a solutions engineer to go deeper on our infra and integration questions.

Availability from our execs next week looks limited but we can do: Tue 6/25 afternoon PT or Thu 6/27 mid-afternoon PT for the exec intro. For the technical deep dive we're targeting the week after (first week of July) for a 60-minute slot.

Can you propose 2x options for the exec intro (30 min) and a couple options for the technical deep dive? Also, can you include the SE who would run the deep dive?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Carter
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up + next steps after today's discovery call

Alex — great to hear, and thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap (high level):
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing features, get predictable cost per request, ensure data isolation + SOC2/audit logging for regulated datasets.
- Constraints: currently on m5-heavy infra, need SSO & KMS integration, rollout across US/EU.

Proposed path to move forward:
1) Executive alignment (30 min) — VP/CTO intro to unblock budget and architecture sign-off. Suggested slots: Wed 6/26 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 6/27 15:00-15:30 PT. I can attend and your CTO is welcome to bring an engineering lead.
2) Technical deep dive (60 min) — SE-led session to review architecture, pilot sizing, and integration checklist. Suggested slots: Wed 7/3 11:00-12:00 PT or Thu 7/4 09:00-10:00 PT. Jonas (copied) will run this.

I attached a short write-up from today's discovery and a one-pager on Redwood's product capabilities for your execs. You can also pick times directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood/exec-intro

If those exec slots don't work, tell me 2x times that do and we'll adapt. Next step from us: once you lock the exec slot we'll send a calendar invite for both sessions and share a short pre-read for the technical call (infra diagram + example prompts).

Attachments:
- discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call + open questions)
- redwood-product-one-pager.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
